IoT-Based Inventory Receiving Device and System
Industrial Operations

IoT-Based Inventory Receiving Device and System

This project was developed to improve industrial receiving operations by automating driver identification and shipment verification at the gate. It addresses manual entry, missing data, delays, and human error by connecting a physical RFID-based prototype to a dashboard database for faster and more accurate processing.

Arduino Uno R4
RFID / RC522 Reader
Dashboard Database
Load Cell Integration
Reads driver identification through RFID scanning and retrieves related shipment data for review at the receiving gate.
Supports worker verification and record updates to reduce manual mistakes and improve workflow tracking.
Was designed around operational pain points such as long waiting time, missing data, and inconsistent receiving records.
For more details about this project expand project explanation
+
The project flow starts when the driver arrives at the gate and scans an RFID card. The system reads the stored driver and shipment information, shows the details on the dashboard for worker review, allows edits when needed, and then stores the approved shipment record in the database.
The solution was designed to reduce manual entry errors, shorten waiting time at receiving gates, improve shipment verification accuracy, and make record tracking more organized across the receiving process.
Main components used in the prototype are shown below.
Arduino Uno R4 Main controller used to run the prototype logic and connect the receiving device components.
RC522 RFID Scanner Used to read the RFID card or tag and retrieve linked driver and shipment information.
Load Cell Included for shipment weight checking and future comparison with expected sample data.
HydraCap
Product Development

HydraCap | Bottle Cap with Integrated Medication Compartment

HydraCap is a product development project centered on making daily medication carrying more practical. The concept integrates medication storage into a bottle-related form so that a commonly used item becomes more functional, convenient, and easy to carry.

Concept Generation
Design Evaluation
Prototyping
Developed around everyday convenience, portability, and better usability for routine medication handling.
Explored multiple integration directions to balance product practicality, accessibility, and design simplicity.
Reflects a user-centered engineering approach that transforms a basic object into a more useful daily solution.
For more details about this project expand project explanation
+
The project addresses a simple but common issue: carrying medication separately can be inconvenient and easy to forget. By integrating a compartment into a bottle-related design, the concept improves everyday portability and ease of access.
Development included concept generation, design evaluation, material selection, and prototyping considerations. The work focused on making the idea practical rather than decorative.
HydraCap represents an engineering mindset that combines function, innovation, and user needs into a product concept with clear daily-life value.
